name: A Bijou for Zanza

guaranteedRewards.name: Zandalar Honor Token
tooltip: Use: Increase your reputation permanently with the Zandalar Tribe.

statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 6,600 experience instead of 9,500, 0.69 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves!

Take any one of the bijous that you find in Zul'Gurub to the Altar of Zanza and destroy it.  For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive.

Witness for yourself the blessings of Zanza!
narrative.objectives: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of Zanza on Yojamba Isle.  When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent... each bijou we wrest away from the Blood God's minions is one step closer we all are to finally defeating them once and for all.  You bring honor to the Zandalar - and yourself - through your noble actions.Remember adventurer, you may always destroy the bijous you find in Zul'Gurub at the altar.  For each one, you will gain recognition and an Honor Token!  Just remember to have an open space in your inventory if you don't have one of the tokens already.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you destroyed the bijou at the Altar of Zanza? Do so, and then you will be doubly blessed by Zanza!
